A leukemoid reaction is an increase in the white blood cell count, which can mimic leukemia . The reaction is actually due to an infection or another disease and is not a sign of cancer. Blood counts often return to normal when the underlying condition is treated. References Nasr MR, Hutchison RE. Leukocytic disorders. In: McPherson RA, Pincus MR, eds.
